# Subway Seat for mako

Notifications on the raised paper ground. Low urgency is quiet, normal has a denim border, critical an orange one, and progress fills in behind the text as a wash that keeps it readable. Settings after the `include=` line still win. Before mako 1.10, paste the file's contents instead.

[mako](https://github.com/emersion/mako) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/mako/) · Needs mako 1.10+

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/mako/config, at the top before any [section], then `makoctl reload`:

```ini
include=~/.config/mako/subway-seat.conf
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/mako/config, at the top before any [section], then `makoctl reload`:

```ini
include=~/.config/mako/subway-seat-tunnel.conf
```

```

```

**London Deep Level**, in ~/.config/mako/config, at the top before any [section], then `makoctl reload`:

```

**London Portland**, in ~/.config/mako/config, at the top before any [section], then `makoctl reload`:

```

**Paris Guimard**, in ~/.config/mako/config, at the top before any [section], then `makoctl reload`:

**Paris Catacombes**, in ~/.config/mako/config, at the top before any [section], then `makoctl reload`:

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/mako/subway-seat.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/mako/subway-seat-tunnel.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/mako/subway-seat-enamel.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/mako/london-moquette.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/mako/london-deep-level.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/mako/london-portland.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/mako/paris-guimard.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/mako/paris-catacombes.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/mako/paris-carrelage.conf`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
